terminology.flight risk: modeled probability an employee leaves in the next 12 months (0-100)
terminology.value score: modeled business value of retaining the employee (0-100)
terminology.act now: high flight-risk AND high value at the same time — the priority quadrant
terminology.key person: high value score; costly and slow to replace
terminology.comp gap: how far base pay sits below the market band for the role
terminology.reason codes: the model's top drivers of a score, each with a direction

comp_bands.below band: pay is under the role's market range; a known retention driver
comp_bands.in band: pay is within the role's market range
comp_bands.above band: pay is above the role's market range

survey_definitions.mobility readiness: panel score for readiness to move into a larger role (0-100)
survey_definitions.learning velocity: panel score for capacity to absorb new learning (0-100)

notes: Talent88 is a financial-services workforce-intelligence demo. Speak plainly to a busy HR manager; refer to people only by token.
